name: agent-notifications-go
description: Smart desktop notifications for Codex task statuses (Go implementation)

interface.shortDescription: Desktop notifications when Codex finishes or needs input
interface.longDescription: Sends desktop notifications (and optional webhooks) when a Codex turn completes, when Codex asks a question, and when a permission request is waiting. Supports click-to-focus, sounds, and per-status filters.
